# Nopedat API

> Netlify-hosted API for reading and updating Nopedat documents for the Nopedat web app, plus Firebase-backed authentication helpers.

Primary app: https://nopedat.web.app

Base URL: https://nopedat.netlify.app

Primary docs:
- Interactive API docs: https://nopedat.netlify.app/
- OpenAPI spec: https://nopedat.netlify.app/openapi.json
- Example note read URL: https://nopedat.netlify.app/api?id={note_id}

## Core note API

- GET /api?id={id}
  Returns the document text as plain text.

- POST /api?id={id}
  Writes the raw request body to the document's text field.

## Auth API

- POST /auth/signup
  Create an email/password account and trigger verification email.

- POST /auth/signin
  Sign in with email/password. Rejects unverified accounts.

- POST /auth/refresh
  Exchange a refresh token for new Firebase tokens.

- POST /auth/password
  Sign in or sign up using a document id plus password.

- POST /auth/update
  Update a user's password using either existing credentials or a valid Firebase ID token.

## Request patterns

- Note writes use a raw text/plain request body rather than JSON.
- Auth endpoints use JSON request bodies.
- Authorization may be passed as a Bearer token header to note and auth update flows.
- CORS preflight is supported on all documented endpoints.

## Recommended source of truth

Use the OpenAPI document at /openapi.json for exact request and response schemas. Use this file as a short routing guide only.

If you need the user-facing product context, start from the Nopedat web app at https://nopedat.web.app and treat this API as its backend service.
